```{r}
#| output: false
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)

d <- readRDS(params$data_path)

fmt_duration <- function(s) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(s), "\u2014",
    ifelse(
      s >= 3600,
      sprintf("%d:%02d:%02d", s %/% 3600, (s %% 3600) %/% 60, round(s %% 60)),
      sprintf("%d:%02d", s %/% 60, round(s %% 60))
    )
  )
}

fmt_pace <- function(min_per_km) {
  if (is.na(min_per_km) || !is.finite(min_per_km)) return("\u2014")
  mins <- floor(min_per_km)
  secs <- round((min_per_km - mins) * 60)
  if (secs == 60) {
    mins <- mins + 1
    secs <- 0
  }
  sprintf("%d:%02d", mins, secs)
}

# Reactable's own filter is a substring match on the rendered text, which is
# useless on a number: "6" matches 6, 16, 0.62 and 106. This one reads the
# underlying value and accepts a comparison (">6", "<=6", "=6"), a range
# ("6:9", "1:", ":8"), or a bare number for an exact match. Rows whose value is
# missing or non-numeric drop out of every filter, and an expression that does
# not parse leaves the rows untouched rather than emptying the table.
#
# JS() here is reactable's re-export of htmlwidgets::JS(), so the template
# needs nothing beyond the two libraries above.
numeric_filter <- JS("
function(rows, columnId, filterValue) {
  if (filterValue === undefined || filterValue === null) return rows

  const s = String(filterValue).trim()
  if (s === '') return rows

  // Helper: filter out missing/non-numeric cell values
  const getValue = function(row) {
    const x = row.values[columnId]
    if (x === null || x === undefined || x === '') return null

    const value = Number(x)
    return Number.isNaN(value) ? null : value
  }

  // Comparison syntax: >6, >=6, <6, <=6, =6, ==6
  const comparison = s.match(/^(<=|>=|<|>|==|=)\\s*(.+)$/)

  if (comparison) {
    const op = comparison[1]
    const x = Number(comparison[2])

    if (Number.isNaN(x)) return rows

    return rows.filter(function(row) {
      const value = getValue(row)
      if (value === null) return false

      switch (op) {
        case '>':  return value > x
        case '>=': return value >= x
        case '<':  return value < x
        case '<=': return value <= x
        case '=':
        case '==': return value === x
      }
    })
  }

  // Range syntax: 1:, :8, 6:9
  if (s.includes(':')) {
    const parts = s.split(':')
    if (parts.length !== 2) return rows

    const lowerText = parts[0].trim()
    const upperText = parts[1].trim()

    const lower = lowerText === '' ? null : Number(lowerText)
    const upper = upperText === '' ? null : Number(upperText)

    if ((lower !== null && Number.isNaN(lower)) ||
        (upper !== null && Number.isNaN(upper))) {
      return rows
    }

    return rows.filter(function(row) {
      const value = getValue(row)
      if (value === null) return false

      if (lower !== null && value < lower) return false
      if (upper !== null && value > upper) return false

      return true
    })
  }

  // Plain number: exact match
  const x = Number(s)
  if (Number.isNaN(x)) return rows

  return rows.filter(function(row) {
    const value = getValue(row)
    return value !== null && value === x
  })
}
")

num_col <- function(name, digits = 1, width = 80, filter = FALSE) {
  colDef(
    name = name, width = width,
    filterable = filter,
    filterMethod = if (filter) numeric_filter,
    cell = function(v) if (is.na(v)) "\u2014" else formatC(v, format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = " ")
  )
}

# Coordinates carry five decimals, about a metre, which is finer than the
# fixes. They are rounded to the same five in R, so what the filter compares
# and what the cell shows are the same number and "=64.14231" matches.
coord_col <- function(name, width = 95) {
  colDef(
    name = name, width = width,
    filterable = TRUE, filterMethod = numeric_filter,
    cell = function(v) if (is.na(v)) "\u2014" else formatC(v, format = "f", digits = 5)
  )
}

# Best split paces read as m:ss but are stored as decimal minutes per km, and
# the filter sees the stored value: "4:30" is the range 4 to 30, not four and a
# half minutes. Ranges want decimals - "<4.5", "4.5:5".
pace_col <- function(name, width = 85) {
  colDef(
    name = name, width = width,
    filterable = TRUE, filterMethod = numeric_filter,
    cell = function(v) fmt_pace(v)
  )
}

int_col <- function(name, width = 75) {
  colDef(
    name = name, width = width, filterable = FALSE,
    cell = function(v) if (is.na(v)) "\u2014" else format(round(v), big.mark = " ")
  )
}

dur_col <- function(name, width = 85) {
  colDef(
    name = name, width = width, filterable = FALSE,
    cell = function(v) fmt_duration(v)
  )
}
```

```{r}
reactable(
  d[, c(
    "activity_date", "activity_id", "activity_name", "activity_type",
    "lat", "lng",
    "distance_km", "elapsed_time_s", "moving_time_s", "best_1k", "best_5k",
    "elevation_gain_m", "average_speed_ms", "max_speed_ms",
    "average_heart_rate", "max_heart_rate", "average_cadence",
    "average_watts", "max_watts", "calories",
    "relative_effort", "perceived_exertion", "activity_gear", "commute",
    "n_rows", "n_rows_gps", "n_rows_dist", "n_rows_speed", "n_rows_hr",
    "n_rows_alt", "n_rows_cad", "n_rows_watts", "stream_columns", "stem"
  )],
  filterable = TRUE,
  searchable = TRUE,
  resizable = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  compact = TRUE,
  wrap = FALSE,
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
  pageSizeOptions = c(25, 50, 100, 250),
  defaultPageSize = 25,
  defaultSorted = list(activity_date = "desc"),
  # Smaller than the page's body text: this table is 30 columns wide and is
  # read by scanning, not by reading.
  defaultColDef = colDef(
    headerStyle = list(fontSize = "0.75rem"),
    style = list(fontSize = "0.8rem")
  ),
  columns = list(
    activity_date = colDef(
      # Date only. The time was clipped by the column anyway, and sorting is
      # on the underlying value, which keeps its time.
      name = "Date", width = 110,
      cell = function(v) if (is.na(v)) "\u2014" else format(v, "%Y-%m-%d")
    ),
    # The id is the natural handle for the Strava link. target="_blank" is
    # required: this page is displayed inside the index's iframe, and Strava
    # sets X-Frame-Options, so an in-frame navigation would just fail blank.
    activity_id = colDef(
      name = "Strava", width = 125,
      cell = function(v) {
        if (is.na(v) || !nzchar(v)) return("\u2014")
        tags$a(href = paste0("https://www.strava.com/activities/", v),
               target = "_blank", rel = "noopener", v)
      }
    ),
    # Links back into the dashboard. The href resolves to the same document as
    # the top frame, so target="_top" makes this a fragment navigation that the
    # index's hashchange handler picks up, rather than a page reload.
    activity_name = colDef(
      name = "Name", minWidth = 265,
      cell = function(v, index) {
        label <- if (is.na(v) || !nzchar(v)) "(unnamed)" else v
        if (isTRUE(d$has_page[index])) {
          tags$a(href = paste0("index.html#", d$activity_id[index]),
                 target = "_top", label)
        } else {
          label
        }
      }
    ),
    activity_type = colDef(name = "Type", width = 100),
    lat = coord_col("Lat"),
    lng = coord_col("Lng"),
    distance_km = num_col("Dist (km)", 2, filter = TRUE),
    elapsed_time_s = dur_col("Elapsed"),
    moving_time_s = dur_col("Moving"),
    best_1k = pace_col("Best 1k"),
    best_5k = pace_col("Best 5k"),
    elevation_gain_m = int_col("Elev +"),
    average_speed_ms = num_col("Avg m/s", 2),
    max_speed_ms = num_col("Max m/s", 2),
    average_heart_rate = int_col("Avg HR"),
    max_heart_rate = int_col("Max HR"),
    average_cadence = int_col("Cadence"),
    average_watts = int_col("Avg W"),
    max_watts = int_col("Max W"),
    calories = int_col("kcal"),
    relative_effort = int_col("Effort"),
    perceived_exertion = int_col("RPE"),
    activity_gear = colDef(name = "Gear", width = 115),
    commute = colDef(name = "Commute", width = 85),
    n_rows = int_col("Points"),
    n_rows_gps = int_col("GPS"),
    n_rows_dist = int_col("Dist pts"),
    n_rows_speed = int_col("Speed pts"),
    n_rows_hr = int_col("HR pts"),
    n_rows_alt = int_col("Alt pts"),
    n_rows_cad = int_col("Cad pts"),
    n_rows_watts = int_col("Watt pts"),
    stream_columns = colDef(name = "Stream columns", minWidth = 240),
    stem = colDef(name = "File", width = 130, show = FALSE)
  )
)
```
